param: collection_name (describe channel integrity during same-name lifecycle churn)

oracle.statement: during create->drop churn every describe answer is a well-formed 200 (result object + status string + config object + params object) or a 404 with a non-empty error message (malformed 200 / bare 404 = Type4 at count>=1; >=2 x 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3, single occurrence inconclusive); after the final delete the settled describe is exactly 404 with a message — a settled 200-with-config = Type1 ghost
